disclaimer: Ringkasan umum dari halaman resmi pemerintah. Kondisi visa tiap pelajar bisa berbeda: cek kondisi visa sendiri (VEVO untuk Australia, eVisa/visa letter untuk Selandia Baru). Bukan nasihat hukum atau migrasi.

work_rights.summary_id: Maksimal 48 jam per dua minggu (fortnight) selama periode kuliah berjalan (termasuk masa ujian). Tidak dibatasi selama libur terjadwal resmi dari institusi.
details: 48 jam per fortnight saat course in session (term, semester, periode ujian).
Tanpa batas jam saat scheduled course breaks.

Tanpa batas jam juga untuk: mahasiswa master by research / doktoral setelah kursus dimulai; setelah menyelesaikan kursus di CoE selama visa masih berlaku; kursus ditunda/ditangguhkan sesuai Standard 9 National Code; enrolment dibatalkan karena provider default (sampai mulai kursus baru).
Kondisi kerja tercantum di visa (condition 8105); cek di VEVO.
work_rights.status: terverifikasi (sumber pemerintah Australia: Study Australia / Austrade)

sources.note: Menyatakan 48 jam/fortnight saat in session, tanpa batas saat libur terjadwal, serta pengecualian di atas. Tidak ada tanggal efektif di halaman.
sources.note_en: States 48 hours/fortnight while in session, unlimited during scheduled breaks, plus the exceptions above. No effective date on the page.

sources.note: Konfirmasi 48 jam/fortnight; merujuk Fair Work Ombudsman untuk upah minimum.
sources.note_en: Confirms 48 hours/fortnight; refers to the Fair Work Ombudsman for minimum wages.

perlu_konfirmasi: Halaman immi.homeaffairs.gov.au 'Work restrictions for student visa holders' yang terbaca saat pengecekan masih menampilkan teks lama era COVID (tidak menyebut 48 jam); halaman kondisi 8105 diblokir robots untuk pengambilan otomatis. Admin perlu cek manual: https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/visas/getting-a-visa/visa-listing/student-500
work_rights.summary_en: Maximum 48 hours per two weeks (fortnight) while your course is in session (including exam periods). Unlimited during the institution's official scheduled breaks.
details_en: 48 hours per fortnight while the course is in session (term, semester, exam periods).
Unlimited hours during scheduled course breaks.

Unlimited hours also for: master by research / doctoral students once their course has started; after completing the course on the CoE while the visa is still valid; course deferred/suspended under Standard 9 of the National Code; enrolment cancelled due to provider default (until a new course starts).
Work conditions are listed on the visa (condition 8105); check in VEVO.
work_rights.status_en: verified (Australian government source: Study Australia / Austrade)
perlu_konfirmasi_en: The immi.homeaffairs.gov.au page 'Work restrictions for student visa holders' read during the check still showed old COVID-era text (does not mention 48 hours); the condition 8105 page is blocked by robots for automated retrieval. Admin needs to check manually: https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/visas/getting-a-visa/visa-listing/student-500

work_rights.summary_id: Jika kondisi visa mengizinkan: maksimal 25 jam per minggu selama masa kuliah; kerja penuh waktu saat libur terjadwal hanya bagi yang memenuhi syarat. Cek eVisa / visa letter.
details: Hingga 25 jam per minggu saat masa kuliah, hanya jika tercantum di kondisi visa.

Tersier: studi penuh waktu dan (a) kualifikasi NZQCF Level 4 ke atas, atau (b) kursus memenuhi syarat durasi minimum, atau (c) studi bahasa Inggris dengan syarat tertentu, atau (d) program exchange/Study Abroad min. 1 semester.
Full-time saat libur terjadwal: min. 1 tahun akademik, kursus min. 120 kredit, min. 2 semester selama min. 8 bulan.
Bahasa Inggris: kursus min. 24 minggu + IELTS overall 5.0 (maks. 2 tahun), ATAU kursus min. 14 minggu berturut-turut di universitas / provider NZQA Category 1.
Sekolah menengah: Year 12/13, usia 16+, izin tertulis sekolah dan orang tua; 25 jam/minggu, full-time saat libur Natal-Tahun Baru.
Doktoral (PhD): tanpa batas jam selama tetap studi penuh waktu.
Micro-credentials dan training schemes tidak memenuhi syarat. Tidak boleh self-employed; harus ada employment agreement.

sources.note: Halaman tidak mencantumkan tanggal efektif/tanggal update. Sebagian teks (durasi minimum kursus tersier) tidak terbaca lengkap.
sources.note_en: The page does not show an effective date/update date. Part of the text (minimum duration of tertiary courses) could not be read in full.

sources.note: Berita perubahan (dari 20 ke 25 jam); hanya ditemukan di hasil pencarian, tidak dibuka.
sources.note_en: News of the change (from 20 to 25 hours); found only in search results, not opened.

perlu_konfirmasi: Detail durasi minimum kursus tersier untuk hak kerja part-time (teks halaman terpotong).
Hak kerja Masters by research tidak dinyatakan tanpa batas di halaman.
work_rights.summary_en: If your visa conditions allow it: maximum 25 hours per week during study periods; full-time work during scheduled holidays only for those who are eligible. Check your eVisa / visa letter.
details_en: Up to 25 hours per week during study periods, only if stated in your visa conditions.

Tertiary: full-time study and (a) an NZQCF Level 4 or higher qualification, or (b) a course that meets the minimum duration requirement, or (c) English language study under certain conditions, or (d) an exchange/Study Abroad program of at least 1 semester.
Full-time during scheduled holidays: at least 1 academic year, a course of at least 120 credits, at least 2 semesters over at least 8 months.
English language: course of at least 24 weeks + IELTS overall 5.0 (max. 2 years old), OR a course of at least 14 consecutive weeks at a university / NZQA Category 1 provider.
Secondary school: Year 12/13, aged 16+, written permission from the school and parents; 25 hours/week, full-time during the Christmas-New Year holidays.
Doctoral (PhD): unlimited hours as long as you continue full-time study.
Micro-credentials and training schemes are not eligible. Self-employment is not allowed; there must be an employment agreement.
perlu_konfirmasi_en: Details of the minimum tertiary course duration for part-time work rights (page text was cut off).
Work rights for Masters by research are not stated as unlimited on the page.

notes: Akomodasi pelajar purpose-built (PBSA) dan asrama universitas sering memakai kontrak 'licence/occupancy agreement' atau rooming accommodation, sehingga aturan bond bisa berbeda dari sewa umum - selalu baca kontrak dan cek ke otoritas negara bagian.
Jangan pernah transfer bond/deposit sebelum melihat kontrak tertulis dan memastikan identitas penyedia.
disclaimer_en: General summary from official government pages. Visa conditions can differ for each student: check your own visa conditions (VEVO for Australia, eVisa/visa letter for New Zealand). Not legal or migration advice.
notes_en: Purpose-built student accommodation (PBSA) and university residences often use a 'licence/occupancy agreement' or rooming accommodation contract, so bond rules may differ from general tenancies - always read the contract and check with the state/territory authority.
Never transfer a bond/deposit before seeing a written contract and verifying the provider's identity.
